results.answer: Whether you can get a refund 45 days after your annual plan renewed depends on the effective date of the policy. Under the 2025 billing policy, annual plans can only be refunded if requested within 30 days of purchase or renewal, meaning a request at 45 days would be denied. However, under the 2026 billing policy (effective 1 March 2026), annual plans can be refunded on a pro-rated basis for unused full months if the request is made within 60 days of the renewal date, meaning a request at 45 days would be eligible.
